intent_contract.text: 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

The requester asks for independent complex image tests using the supplied image. This arm independently chooses an original synthetic song-performer costume fitting during projection-gallery assembly. The experience is a tactile engineered silhouette interrupted by a brief, quiet camera acknowledgment: paired hair sections and audio devices establish the head, collar and tie organize the torso, detached sleeves lead to active fingers at a modular waistband, and pleats and tall boots continue the structure to the floor. Dusty violet, graphite and copper echo the partially installed screen. The face uses the supplied image as an appearance reference, without claiming that the photographed adult model is the real reference person or inferring personality, biography or actual age. The palette, costume structures, setting, fitted gesture and camera treatment are agent-owned choices; the raw requester text names none of these visual keywords. Controls add subtle sensual presence, no fetish direction and no added surreal treatment.

A complex photographic study of a reference-informed model in an installation gallery: an adult woman, using the supplied reference for facial appearance, pauses while fastening the waist panel of an original synthetic song-performer costume. Her face preserves the reference's facial proportions, eye shape, nose and mouth; her eyes meet the camera with a quiet, attentive expression. Dusty-violet twin tails descend from two angular clips above and behind the ears, their long sections falling behind her arms. Copper headset housings sit over both ears; a slim boom from the housing on her left ends beside the corner of her mouth. A graphite sleeveless fitted bodice rises into a standing collar, with a narrow copper tie laid down its center and ending above the belt. Detached long sleeves begin below the shoulders, exposing distinct upper-arm intervals; squared wrist cuffs finish before her hands. A belt supports a short fan-pleated overskirt and a translucent side panel curving toward a front buckle. At the front of the waistband, her left thumb and forefinger guide the panel tab into a buckle steadied by her right hand, with elbows softly bent and fingers visible beyond both cuffs. Graphite boots rise to mid-thigh, leaving a visible leg interval between each boot top and the skirt hem. Both feet rest on the gallery floor in a stable, slightly staggered stance. Her figure and the unfinished display form a complex interrelated visual arrangement. A partially mounted translucent screen stands behind her on an aluminum frame; a worktable to her side holds cable coils, tape, paper patterns and cut material, with floor-position tape extending toward the frame. Photograph her whole figure including both boot soles from a near-frontal three-quarter view, with the table beside her silhouette. Broad neutral overhead light keeps the face and garment joins legible; a low amber work lamp gives the copper seams and nearby screen an understated warm gleam. Natural skin texture, fabric creases and brushed metal surfaces retain the sense of a physical costume fitting.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. authorial_direction.interpreted_intent: The requester asks for independent complex image tests using the supplied image. This arm independently chooses an original synthetic song-performer costume fitting during projection-gallery assembly. The experience is a tactile engineered silhouette interrupted by a brief, quiet camera acknowledgment: paired hair sections and audio devices establish the head, collar and tie organize the torso, detached sleeves lead to active fingers at a modular waistband, and pleats and tall boots continue the structure to the floor. Dusty violet, graphite and copper echo the partially installed screen. The face uses the supplied image as an appearance reference, without claiming that the photographed adult model is the real reference person or inferring personality, biography or actual age. The palette, costume structures, setting, fitted gesture and camera treatment are agent-owned choices; the raw requester text names none of these visual keywords. Controls add subtle sensual presence, no fetish direction and no added surreal treatment.
visual_priorities: The reference-informed face stays readable between paired long hair sections and separate ear-mounted audio housings with a mouth-adjacent boom.
The standing collar and narrow central tie organize the sleeveless fitted torso rather than dissolving into headset or waistband detail.
Separate sleeve tops, upper-arm intervals and wrist cuffs leave the two fingertip roles at the front buckle understandable.
The belt physically supports fan-fold pleats and a translucent side module, connecting the wearing action with the unfinished display.
Tall boot shafts, leg intervals below the skirt and two floor-supported feet complete one readable costume silhouette.
The partially installed screen and restrained working traces establish the gallery while neutral light keeps the model primary.

baseline_review.summary: A human adult model stands on two feet while both hands fasten a front waistband buckle. Paired hair and headset remain head-owned; detached sleeves are garment pieces supported by upper-arm bands. The panel is lightweight and its front tab lies within both hands natural waist-level reach. Support, attachment, hand contact, cloth clearance and projection were checked jointly in the authored baseline; this is agent plausibility evidence rather than rendered proof.

body_ownership.reason: Both acting hands belong to the one described model. Left fingers manipulate the panel tab and the right hand stabilizes the front buckle; the mic belongs to her left ear housing and hair falls behind her own arms. Sleeves and boots are worn components, not extra limbs.
